name: Starter Secured
summary: Learn how a refundable deposit may relate to credit limits, billing and possible upgrades.
plainEnglish: A secured credit card usually requires a cash deposit that may help establish a credit line. It is not the same as a prepaid card.
watchOut: Review whether the issuer reports to credit bureaus and the rules for refunds, upgrades, late fees and closure.
limitations: This example does not specify an actual minimum deposit or credit eligibility rules.
